Meet Pixph, the capture workspace for Mac.

Select text in any app. Press Shift twice. It's saved, organized, and ready when you are.

No more losing the line you meant to come back to. No more juggling tabs just to hold onto an idea. Pixph sits quietly in the background and catches what matters, then gets out of your way again.

- One-time purchase, no subscription
- Local by default, your notes stay yours

Grab it https://pixph.com
